status: provisional AI reconciliation; not human gold
reviewer: Codex AI reconciliation of an earlier independent AI second review
method: Read the complete frozen title and abstract of each of the 67 change_suggested records, then reconcile each proposed change against the existing README scope and track conventions. Both prior annotations and second-review suggestions were visible; this is not a blinded or human review. No new source retrieval or full-text review was performed.
rules: Accept explicitly evaluated downstream tasks; background applications alone do not establish a track.
Defer unsettled auxiliary preprocessing, foundation-model reuse and molecular-status label boundaries.
Do not promote reader assistance, image quality review or expert annotation alone into confirmed human_loop. Explicit evaluated real-user interaction can support a provisional addition.
Apply no proposed label changes from the 85 boundary_review_required or 31 missing_abstract_unverified records.
All 400 labels, including accepted corrections and AI agreement, remain unconfirmed provisional annotations.

decisions.title: ASAP: Advancing Medical Volumetric Representation Learning with Anatomy-aware Semantically-adaptive Pre-training
decisions.reason: 完整摘要明确列出22项下游任务，并报告跨任务实验，其中包括异常分类、分割和疾病预后预测；三项补标均对应实际评估，而不是背景示例。

decisions.title: A cross-modal generative model for incomplete and degraded prostate MRI with multicentre clinical validation
decisions.reason: 独立200例诊断评估报告临床显著癌症AUC，支持补充diagnosis。1000例读片主要评价重建图像质量；读片实验是否足以构成human_loop仍属待定边界，暂不增补。

decisions.title: SEEG Contact Detector: A 3D Slicer Extension for Automated Localisation of Intracranial Electrode Contacts
decisions.reason: 提出的电极定位方法明确以概率分割电极结构作为算法组成，支持segmentation。7条电极通过扩展工具人工修正属交互线索，但是否满足临床human_loop研究口径尚未统一，保留原human_loop缺省。
pendingBoundaryDecisions: human_loop: manual correction versus evaluated clinical interaction

decisions.title: An Interpretable Deep Learning Framework for Discovery and Clinical Validation of Deep Radiomic Signatures in Tumor Classification
decisions.reason: 摘要将已有稳健分割模型用于先行勾画，主要贡献和验证是签名提取、分类与影像组学；没有独立分割性能终点。辅助预处理是否单独计入方向尚待裁定，保留原标签。

decisions.title: PRISM: Phase-Resolved Isotropic Subtraction Mapping for Automated Multi-Phase CT Digital Subtraction Angiography
decisions.reason: RIFE插值和TotalSegmentator分割是六阶段流水线的既有工具，报告的系统实验集中于配准配置和增强图阈值。是否将辅助插值/分割分别记为reconstruction/segmentation尚未统一，保留原标签。

decisions.title: RadJEPA: Radiology Encoder for Chest X-Rays via Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture
decisions.reason: 摘要明确说明除报告生成外还实施分类与分割迁移实验；补充diagnosis和segmentation有实际评估依据。

decisions.title: From Redaction to Restoration: Deep Learning for Medical Image Deidentification and Reconstruction.
decisions.reason: 完整摘要报告下游解剖分割的Dice对照结果，不仅是PHI文本区域检测或一般用途描述，支持补充segmentation。

decisions.title: AI-driven radiomics and functional imaging integration for intelligent identification of coronary high-risk plaques and prediction of cardiovascular events.
decisions.reason: U-Net冠脉分割被描述为影像组学之前的处理步骤；结果仅给出斑块/风险模型的分类与预后指标，未单独评价分割。辅助分割标注口径待定，保留原值。

decisions.title: Validating Artificial Intelligence Guidance for Ultrasound Acquisition and Remote Interpretation
decisions.reason: 前瞻性研究明确以近端DVT敏感性、特异性及分诊表现为终点，并给出结果，符合既定诊断准确性评估口径，补充diagnosis。

decisions.title: Registration-guided GAN Synthesis of Virtual Contrast-enhanced Thoracic CT for Hilar and Mediastinal Lymph Node Detection.
decisions.reason: 原始CT与加入合成CT后的医生检测AUC对照是明确读片实验，但reader study是否直接纳入human_loop仍未统一；保留已有重建、配准和诊断标签。

decisions.title: Streamline pathology foundation model by cross-magnification distillation
decisions.reason: 病理模型在六项临床任务上评估，并明确报告诊断准确率与跨机构验证；diagnosis不是仅据背景中的临床部署措辞推断。

decisions.title: DiffUS: Differentiable Ultrasound Rendering from Volumetric Imaging.
decisions.reason: 实际实验是从脑MRI生成超声图像；术中引导与配准仅作为动机或后续用途，未报告导航/治疗实验。删除intervention并保留reconstruction。

decisions.title: LM-CartSeg: Automated Segmentation of Lateral and Medial Cartilage and Subchondral Bone for Radiomics Analysis
decisions.reason: 摘要明确进行OA与非OA分类，并报告两个队列的AUC；支持在分割、定量基础上补充diagnosis。

decisions.title: Expert Discrimination of AI-Generated versus Authentic Radiologic Images: A Multimodal, Pre-Registered Visual Turing Test
decisions.reason: 该实验评价专家识别合成/真实影像的能力，不评价临床诊断辅助。是否将这类人机评估排除出human_loop属于尚未确认的标签边界，本轮保留原值并标记，避免单方面改变定义。

decisions.title: GliomaINK: A Tumor and Anatomy Conditioned Flow Matching Framework for 3D MRI Sequence Synthesis in Glioma Patients
decisions.reason: 摘要明确列出并评价肿瘤分割，且将总生存预测列为下游实验，支持补充segmentation和prognosis。IDH1分子状态分类是否映射为quantification而非diagnosis尚未统一，暂不增补quantification。

decisions.title: Late-Onset Type I Left Ventricular Rupture Following Double Valve Replacement: An Unexpected Cause of Cardiac Tamponade.
decisions.reason: 超声心动图发现心包异常，CT显示造影剂外渗并确认破裂部位；多模态影像是病例诊断和病因刻画的核心证据，符合adjacent，不能仅因没有算法而判out。

decisions.title: Anatomy-Grounded Weakly Supervised Prompt Tuning for Chest X-ray Latent Diffusion Models
decisions.reason: 实际工作是改善报告文本与胸片区域对齐，并评估短语定位和疾病分类；扩散模型只是骨干，摘要没有图像合成质量实验。改为language、diagnosis并移除reconstruction。

decisions.title: A Novel AI-Assisted 3D Hybrid Soft and Hard Tissue Model for Peri-implant Diagnosis and Treatment Planning: A Proof-of-Concept Study of Immediate Implant Planning in the Anterior Maxilla.
decisions.reason: 三名医生确实比较常规与模型辅助种植规划，并报告定位一致性；但辅助决策/读片实验纳入human_loop的统一阈值尚未确定，暂保留原值而不把该具体建议视为已确认。

decisions.title: Long-Term Volumetric Increase of a Free Omental Flap in Breast Reconstruction: A Case Report with a Focus on Body Weight Correlation.
decisions.reason: 五年CT及三维软件测得皮瓣体积变化，并把体积与体重的相关性作为主要发现。影像定量是核心证据，支持adjacent与quantification；单病例且未提出计算算法，不升级core。

decisions.title: CardioMorphNet: Cardiac Motion Prediction Using a Shape-Guided Bayesian Recurrent Deep Network
decisions.reason: 提出的贝叶斯网络包含双心室分割与运动估计两个后验模型，且验证了临床指标提取准确性；两项均属方法和评估内容，支持segmentation、quantification。

decisions.title: OncoVision: Integrating Mammography and Clinical Data through Attention-Driven Multimodal AI for Enhanced Breast Cancer Diagnosis
decisions.reason: 明确从预测掩膜提取形状、强度、纹理影像组学特征并纳入融合策略，支持quantification。六名医生辅助评估的human_loop归属仍待统一；输出十个结构化临床特征/模板报告不足以确定language任务，暂缓这两项。
pendingBoundaryDecisions: language: structured feature output versus language generation

decisions.title: Combined Model Integrating Clinical-Imaging and Deep Learning to Discriminate Between Persistent Inflammatory and Malignant Subsolid Pulmonary Nodules.

decisions.title: Transcranial FUS Therapy and Monitoring using Nonlinear Acoustics
decisions.reason: 可用摘要的贡献是声学全息透镜优化、无需影像的对准和非线性声学监测；MRI仅为被替代的依赖，未报告医学影像输入或分析实验。按现有核心定义改out并清除intervention，不推断未提供的全文内容。

decisions.title: A Pathology Foundation Model for Gastric Cancer with Real-World Validation
decisions.reason: 28项临床任务中明确包含并评价预后预测，支持prognosis；分子分型AUC本身不足以确定其应归quantification，暂缓此映射。原human_loop不改，但摘要已报告随机交叉读片的准确率和时间结果，原备注中的仅有动机描述需澄清。

decisions.title: Clinician-Friendly Foundation Models for Ophthalmic Image Diagnostics without Fine-Tuning or Technical Barriers

decisions.title: Ultrasound Tomography of Musculoskeletal Tissues with Generative Neural Physics

decisions.title: Markerless Augmented Reality Registration for Surgical Guidance: A Multi-Anatomy Clinical Accuracy Study

decisions.title: ¹⁸F-sodium fluoride PET/CT as a complementary measure of osteoblastic disease burden in axial spondyloarthritis: a prospective exploratory study.

decisions.title: Interpretable Similarity of Synthetic Image Utility

decisions.title: Frequency-Domain Reconstruction of the Speed of Sound in Ring-Array Ultrasound Computed Tomography With Stochastic Phase Encoding.

decisions.title: Leveraging Cell-level Spatial Transcriptomics as Weak Supervision for Nuclei Classification

decisions.title: The Incidence of Radiographic Markers of Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension in Those With Spontaneous Cerebrospinal Fluid Leak.

decisions.title: COBRA2026: a large-scale multicenter pelvic cone-beam computed tomography projection dataset

decisions.title: Validation of individualized flow simulations for determining the pressure gradient in patients with renal artery stenosis
decisions.reason: CTA-CFD模型除压力梯度定量外，还对血流动力学显著狭窄报告敏感性和特异性，符合诊断准确性评估口径，补充diagnosis。

decisions.title: Efficient Image Registration for Ultrasound Localization Microscopy by Obtaining Gradients via Integration Across Iterations
decisions.reason: 方法除配准误差外，实际生成离体心脏ULM超分辨影像并报告219微米空间分辨率；重建/超分辨成像是已演示输出，接受reconstruction。

decisions.title: Recursive Uncertainty-Gated Image Registration for Learning-based Algorithms
decisions.reason: 不仅给出形变/MSE结果，摘要还明确验证射血分数估计相对于真值的误差改善，支持quantification。

decisions.title: Towards Accessible Radiological Image Analysis via Local Agentic Framework: Validation in Mammography
decisions.reason: LLM代理承担已有乳腺影像软件的重建、优化和修改，摘要未描述图文理解、文本报告输入或生成任务；不把使用LLM开发工具等同language方向，保留diagnosis。

decisions.title: An Agentic Multimodal Sensing Architecture for CT-Guided Wearable and Respiratory Monitoring in Oncology Care.
decisions.reason: 实现的是六个有界软件代理和确定性监测叠加，未报告语言模型或图文语言处理；agentic命名不足以支持language，移除该标签并保留真实CT分割实验对应segmentation。

decisions.title: A stacking model for AI-assisted diagnosis of suspected pituitary microadenomas on non-contrast T1COR MRI: a multicenter reader study on bridging the experience gap.
decisions.reason: 明确开发并验证手工影像组学和深度影像组学基模型，再与其他特征堆叠融合，quantification有具体方法依据；原diagnosis及human_loop不在本条修改范围。
